how_to_apply: Visit the official BRIC INSTEM website
Navigate to the "Careers" section and click on "Open Positions."
Select the relevant post code and read the eligibility criteria carefully.
Register with a valid email ID and mobile number, then fill in the online application form.
Upload scanned copies of your photograph, signature, and required certificates.
Pay the prescribed application fee online (if applicable to your category).
Enter the payment reference/transaction number in the application form where required.
Review all entries carefully and submit the form before the closing date, as no corrections are allowed after submission.
Download and save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.
important_instructions: Applications must be complete in all respects; incomplete or defective applications shall be summarily rejected without notice. The crucial date for determining eligibility, including age, qualification, and experience, is the closing date of submission of applications. Candidates may apply for more than one post, but a separate application and fee must be submitted for each post. All communication with candidates will be made only through the registered email ID; candidates should regularly check the Institute's website for updates and corrigenda. Candidature remains provisional until verification of original documents at the interview/skill/trade test stage. Canvassing in any form shall result in disqualification. Selected candidates shall be liable to serve anywhere in India as per Institute requirements. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the CBT/Interview/Skill Test/Trade Test. All direct recruitment appointments are subject to a probation period of two years. Any dispute related to this recruitment shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts at Bengaluru.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat GSSSB Style Vacancy Table: BRIC INSTEM Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: BRIC INSTEM, Bengaluru has announced a total of 14 vacancies across Technical Cadre and Administrative Cadre positions. The post-wise vacancy break-up, including category-wise reservation, is given below.

content_sections.heading: BRIC INSTEM Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must be Indian Nationals and should carefully check the post-wise educational qualification, experience, and age limit before applying online. There is no upper age limit for employees who have been engaged in the work of the Institute or Department for 5 years or more as of 28.02.2020. Age relaxation for SC, ST, OBC (NCL), EWS, and PwBD candidates is applicable strictly as per extant Government of India rules.

rows.post_name: Senior Technical Officer (Lab Support) / (Scientific Facility Support)
rows.essential_qualification_experience: BE/B-Tech (in relevant field) with minimum 5 years' experience in maintenance of large installations for institutes/industry engaged in Research & Scientific work. Desirable: 60% marks in aggregate/post-graduation.

BE/B-Tech (in relevant field) with 1-2 years' experience preferably in a research establishment, OR 3-year Diploma in Engineering with minimum 5 years' relevant experience. Desirable: 60% marks in aggregate.

rows.post_name: Technical Assistant (Instrumentation / Lab Support / HVAC / Civil)
rows.essential_qualification_experience: BE/B-Tech (in relevant field) with 1-2 years' experience in engineering and 1-2 years' experience in maintenance of large installations for institutes/industry. Desirable: 60% marks in aggregate.

Graduate/PG Diploma in Financial Management/Materials Management/Personnel Management with minimum 5 years' experience in Accounting/Finance/Admin/Purchase/Establishment/Hospitality. Knowledge of Tally ERP or similar package is essential; at least 3 years must be at supervisory level.

Graduate in any discipline with knowledge of personal computers and applications. Desirable: 4 years' experience in Administration/Accounts/Procurement/Purchase/Stores/Establishment/Secretariat, preferably in Govt./Autonomous Institutions.

content_sections.heading: BRIC INSTEM Salary 2026: Pay Scale & Benefits
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be placed at the Entry Level of the applicable Pay Level under the 7th CPC Pay Matrix, depending on the post. Senior Technical Officer: Pay Level PL-09 Technical Officer-I / Management Assistant: Pay Level PL-07 Technical Assistant / Junior Management Assistant: Pay Level PL-06 In addition to basic pay, selected candidates are eligible for Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance (in lieu of accommodation), Transport Allowance, Children Education Allowance, Leave Travel Concession, and Medical Facilities as applicable. Selected candidates will be covered under the National Pension System (NPS).

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced in BRIC-inStem Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 14 vacancies have been announced across Technical Cadre and Administrative Cadre posts under Advertisement No. BRIC-inStem/02/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for BRIC-inStem Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of the online application is 25.09.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for BRIC-inStem Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹472/- (₹400/- plus 18% GST) for UR, EWS, and OBC (NCL) candidates. SC/ST, Women, Ex-Servicemen, and PwBD candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for BRIC-inStem posts?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post and ranges from a Graduate degree (for Junior Management Assistant) to a BE/B-Tech with relevant experience (for Technical Officer and Technical Assistant posts) and a Graduate/PG Diploma with supervisory experience (for Management Assistant). Full details are not available for post-specific desirable criteria beyond what is stated in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for BRIC-inStem Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection involves scrutiny of online applications followed by a Computer-Based Test (CBT) and Interview, Skill Test, and Trade Test, wherever applicable.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for BRIC-inStem Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the "Careers – Open Positions" section on the official BRIC-inStem website: instem.res.in/jobportal.

faq.question: Q7. Is there an age relaxation for reserved category candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is applicable for SC, ST, OBC (NCL), EWS, and PwBD candidates strictly in accordance with extant Government of India rules, as detailed in the age limit table above.

faq.question: Q8. What is the pay level for BRIC-inStem posts?
faq.answer: Pay levels range from PL-06 to PL-09 under the 7th CPC Pay Matrix, depending on the post, along with allowances such as DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, and NPS coverage.
